segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin find the serum lightweight and non-occlusive, unlike heavier serums they have tried, and say it works well as their only nighttime step after cleansing.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one with a persistently flaky forehead in winter, report the serum resolves flaking and leaves skin visibly more hydrated without irritation.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports enjoying the product alongside fine, hereditary wrinkles around her mouth.
segments.sensitive: Multiple self-described sensitive-skin reviewers, including one managing rosacea-related redness, report no irritation or breakouts, though one separately notes the fragrance sometimes irritates her eyes.
segments.normal: The one reviewer identifying as having normal skin (neither dry nor oily) says the serum alone is enough most days, with smoother skin and less visible under-eye wrinkles.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s through 70s consistently report firmer, lifted skin with reduced sagging along the jawline and cheeks and softer fine lines, often noticed within days.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers report visibly firmer, lifted skin with reduced fine lines, sagging, and smile lines, some noticing a difference after a single use; two reviewers say they saw no real difference or that the product did not absorb.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers, including several with dry or flaky skin, describe strong and lasting hydration with plumper-looking skin; one reviewer says the hydrating effect fades within one to three hours.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness-prone or rosacea skin report calmer, less red skin after use, with one specifically calling the product rosacea-friendly.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fading or less noticeable dark spots, and one separately mentions lightened dark circles under the eyes.
concerns.blemishes: Long-term and self-described acne-prone users mostly report clear skin with no new breakouts, but three reviewers describe breakouts after starting the product, including one who saw the same reaction recur when she resumed use after a break.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily-leaning skin describe the serum as lightweight and non-occlusive compared to heavier serums, with one reporting a zero-oil finish the morning after use.

extraits.texte: So so sad that this didn't work out. It smells amazing and I love the texture but unfortunately it broke me out pretty bad. I introduced it to my skincare routine and within a week my skin was wrecked. I usually don't break out at all, ever, and I'm used to using some pretty heavy stuff on the skin such as various oils, balms, butters, etc. I've finally gotten my skin to a point where it's clear again but I do have a small scar on my forehead from this stuff which is annoying. Hopefully it'll fade with time. I think it's the coconut-derived ingredients. I wish natural skincare brands didn't rely so heavily on coconut everything!

extraits.titre: Good until it broke me out
extraits.texte: I really felt like this product was working for my fine lines. Its thick, has an okay smells and left my skin feeling tighter and looking brighter. The downside however is that after a week of use, I started to break out in spots/zits which is unusual for me. I gave it s break and they cleared up. Started using thr product again and the same break outs occurred.

This product is about half the price of the Peach and Lilys's copper peptide serum and eorks so much better. Unlike that other serum, it is not irritating to my redness-prone facial complexion. I put the Mad Hippie serum at night with a moisturizer over it. In the morning, my skin tone looks healthy, calm, and not red at all, and the large pores on my nose and cheeks are reduced by at least 50%. I am 53 and have always been prone to acne breakouts, although my skin is drier now. No problems with this product. Already purchased a second bottle.

My skin is definitely plumper with more of a moisturized / brighter appearance and the sagging around my cheeks and chin is definitely less noticeable. I will for sure be keeping this product in my permanent skincare lineup. I have sensitive skin too and no irritation whatsoever. For reference, I'm 42 years old.
